```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
```

# load data
```{r}
CoRR <- read.csv("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/ppiio/data/derived/2025-02-17/CoRR_formatted.csv") 

df <- CoRR %>%
  select("ppi", "abx_iostart", "staging", "cci_number", "days", "vitalstatus", "chemo_greater_one_year")
```

# model for all cancers 
```{r}
model <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi +  abx_iostart + staging + cci_number, data = df)
summary(model)

colSums(is.na(df[, c( "ppi", "abx_iostart", "staging", "cci_number")]))
```
# chemo greater than one year 
```{r}
df_chemo <- df[which(df$chemo_greater_one_year == 1),]
model2 <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi + abx_iostart + staging + cci_number, data = df_chemo)
summary(model2)
colSums(is.na(df_chemo[, c( "ppi", "abx_iostart", "staging", "cci_number")]))
```
